structured_tasks.task_title: Task: Build a todo list app

tasks.title: Set up the project environment using Vite with React and TypeScript
subtasks: Run 'npm create vite@latest todo-app --template react-ts' to create the project.
Navigate to the project directory and install dependencies.
Install additional dependencies: Tailwind CSS, uuid.
Initialize Tailwind CSS by running 'npx tailwindcss init' and configure template paths.
acceptance_criteria: Project initializes without errors.
Tailwind CSS is configured correctly and styles are applied.
Development server runs successfully.

tasks.title: Define Data Model, State Management, and Persistence Logic
subtasks: Create 'src/types/todo.ts' to define the `Todo` and `TodoState` TypeScript interfaces.
Create 'src/utils/storage.ts' to create a reusable wrapper for localStorage save/load operations.
Implement the 'src/hooks/useTodos.ts' custom hook for all todo state management logic (add, delete, toggle, edit).
Integrate `uuid` for collision-resistant ID generation for new todos.
Ensure state changes are synced with localStorage to persist data across page reloads.
acceptance_criteria: Todo data model is strongly typed.
State logic is encapsulated within the useTodos hook.
Data correctly persists in localStorage and reloads on page refresh.

tasks.title: Develop and Style Core UI Components
subtasks: Create 'src/components/TodoInput.tsx' for the new todo input form.
Create 'src/components/TodoItem.tsx' to display an individual todo with checkbox and delete button.
Create 'src/components/TodoList.tsx' to render the list of all todo items.
Assemble all components in 'src/App.tsx' to form the main application layout.
Apply Tailwind CSS classes to all components for a clean, modern, and responsive UI.
Ensure the application is fully responsive and usable on both mobile and desktop screen sizes.
acceptance_criteria: Users can add, view, and delete todos through the UI.
Components are modular and reusable.
Styling is consistent and the layout is responsive.

tasks.title: Implement Enhanced Features
subtasks: Implement inline text editing functionality for existing todos in `TodoItem.tsx`.
Create 'src/components/TodoFilters.tsx' to allow users to filter todos by status (all/active/completed).
Add a 'Clear Completed' button to bulk-remove all completed todos.
Display a dynamic counter showing the number of active items left.
Implement user-friendly empty states for when the todo list is empty or a filter yields no results.
acceptance_criteria: All enhanced features are fully functional and integrated into the UI.
The app state updates correctly in response to filtering and bulk actions.

tasks.title: Write Unit Tests for Core Logic and Components
subtasks: Set up Jest and React Testing Library for the project.
Create 'tests/hooks/useTodos.test.tsx' to test the state management logic.
Create 'tests/components/TodoInput.test.tsx' for the TodoInput component.
Create 'tests/components/TodoItem.test.tsx' for the TodoItem component.
Create 'tests/components/TodoList.test.tsx' for the TodoList component.
Configure test coverage reporting and ensure coverage is above 80%.
acceptance_criteria: All unit tests pass successfully.
Coverage reports show over 80% for critical logic and components.

tasks.title: Write Integration and End-to-End Tests
subtasks: Set up an E2E testing framework such as Cypress or Playwright.
Create an integration test file 'tests/integration/todo-workflow.test.ts'.
Write test scenarios that cover the full user workflow: adding, editing, completing, filtering, and deleting todos.
Verify that data persistence works correctly across user actions within the E2E tests.
acceptance_criteria: Key user flows are tested from end-to-end.
E2E tests pass reliably in a headless browser environment.

tasks.title: Create Project Documentation
subtasks: Write 'README.md' with a project overview, features, setup instructions, and usage examples.
Write 'ARCHITECTURE.md' explaining the system design, component hierarchy, state management strategy, and data flow.
Generate 'API.md' with documentation for major components (props) and the `useTodos` hook (functions and state).
acceptance_criteria: Documentation is clear, comprehensive, and understandable.
All major components, features, and architectural decisions are documented.

tasks.title: Perform Security Audit and Hardening
subtasks: Run 'npm audit --production' to check for vulnerabilities in dependencies and address any critical issues.
Implement input sanitization in 'TodoInput.tsx' to prevent potential Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities.
Add robust error handling for localStorage operations, such as when the storage quota is exceeded.
Review the application against the OWASP Top 10 for web applications.
acceptance_criteria: No critical security vulnerabilities are found in the final code or its dependencies.
User input is properly handled to prevent common security risks.

tasks.title: Enforce Code Quality and Best Practices
subtasks: Configure and run ESLint to check for code quality issues and enforce coding standards.
Set up Prettier to ensure consistent code formatting across the entire codebase.
Run the TypeScript compiler in strict mode (`tsc --noEmit`) to catch any type-related errors.
Review code to ensure it follows React best practices, such as using keys for lists and memoizing components where necessary.
acceptance_criteria: Code passes all linting and formatting checks without errors.
The project compiles successfully with no TypeScript errors.

execution_order.note: Implementation phase - sequential execution, building core logic, UI, and features.
Quality Assurance phase - all tasks can run in parallel after implementation is complete.
